name: Quinn Yorick
summary: At the Ivar Patch, Quinn Yorick lies wounded and hidden from the ghoul that struck him. The Forsaken scout cannot finish his mission or retreat alone.

sections.title: A Precarious Refuge
sections.body: Quinn Yorick is a Forsaken scout hiding upstairs in a ruined farmhouse at the Ivar Patch. Ivar the Foul, a ghoul in the farm’s barn in northern Silverpine Forest, wounded him in a fierce clash. Quinn and his sister Rane were sent to scout Silverpine and report to High Executor Hadrec. Too badly hurt to finish their mission or retreat safely alone, he waits in hiding. Travelers serving the Forsaken bring him healing and face the creature that nearly tore him apart.

faq.answer: Quinn Yorick hides upstairs in a ruined farmhouse at the Ivar Patch, north of the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest.
Ivar the Foul, a ghoul lurking in the farm’s barn, badly wounded Quinn Yorick.

faq.q: What role does Quinn serve for Horde adventurers?
faq.answer: Quinn’s sister, the Deathstalker Rane Yorick, sends travelers to bring him a healing potion. Once he takes it, she asks them to kill Ivar the Foul so Quinn can recover.

angles.text: As an Undead, Quinn’s plight shows the danger ghouls and beasts pose to Forsaken forces securing northern Silverpine.
